summary: Defines a piece of the Management Information Base (MIB) for network management protocols. It extends the Ethernet-like interfaces MIB with objects for managing Power Sourcing Equipment (PSE), the devices that supply power over Ethernet cables. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Some network cables also carry electricity to power things like phones. This document is a list of dials and gauges that let a manager check and control the gear that sends that power.

questions: how to manage poe equipment with snmp
